youtube_title: Nearly HALF of 2025's IPOs Went Below Issue Price 📉 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess: of 2025's IPOs, how many were below their issue price by year end?

103 IPOs listed in 2025. By the end of the year, 47 traded below issue price. Nearly half. The hype is already in the price, and in many IPOs the old owners are selling their shares to you.

Rule: read what the company does and why it's raising money. Can't explain it in 2 lines? Skip.
Moral: Hype is not a business plan.

Source: IANS data on 2025 listings (30 Dec 2025)
Education only, not investment advice.
